title: Context-sliced diagnostic bundles and prioritized repro hints for on-call responders
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: on-call responders often receive large noisy snapshots that contain the signal spread across many sources (logs, traces, metrics, kvcache). This PR introduces a new feature in incident-bot that constructs "context-sliced diagnostic bundles": focused, time-bounded collections of artifacts plus automatically generated prioritized reproduction hints (short, actionable repro steps prioritized by estimated likelihood). The goal is to reduce mean time to mitigation by surfacing compact, high-value reproductions and the minimal set of artifacts needed to validate them. What this PR does: 1) Adds a new bundler pipeline (pkg/diag/bundler.go) that can create slices by time-window, affected-service tag, and causal-span ancestry heuristics. 2) Implements a lightweight repro-hint generator (pkg/diag/repro_ranker.go) that ranks short reproduction steps derived from logs, recent deploys, and error-class fingerprints. 3) Exposes a new REST endpoint on the incident-bot API (cmd/incident-bot/http_handlers.go) to request a bundle by incident id with parameters for window size and priority level. 4) Adds UI fixtures for render previews in the runbook editor and a toggle to attach prioritized repro hints to playbook suggestions. Design highlights: - Context slicing uses a hybrid heuristic: start from incident anchor points (alerts + traced error spans), expand to N hops of span ancestry, and intersect with time-windowed logs/metrics. This keeps artifact size bounded while preserving causal context. - Repro hint ranking uses three signals: presence of deterministic error patterns in logs (high weight), recent config/deploy events touching the same service (medium), and correlated metric anomalies across replicas (low). Hints are surfaced as 1-3 short steps; each step includes a confidence score and the minimal evidence set. Backwards compatibility: the API returns a legacy "flat" bundle when the new params aren't provided, preserving existing consumers. Rollout plan: feature-flagged behind incident-bot config (ENV: BUNDLE_MODE=legacy|sliced). Start with rollout to internal SRE on-call for two weeks, collect feedback, then flip globally. Testing: unit tests for bundler and ranker (test/diag/*), two integration scenarios replaying historical incidents (test/integration/bundle_replay.yml), and a smoke e2e against a local sim cluster. CI summary: lint, unit, integration (recorded flakiness on the second integration job owing to timing; retried and passed). Checklist: - [x] Implementation of bundler pipeline - [x] Repro hint generator and ranking - [x] API endpoint and flag gating - [x] Unit and integration tests - [x] Docs: runbook editor usage and developer notes - [x] Add observability: metrics for bundle size, repro hint acceptance, generation latency Migration notes: existing runbook attachments remain valid; consumers that want the new format must pass the query param bundle=sliced. Observability: new metrics incidentbot.bundle.size_bytes, incidentbot.repro.hints_generated, incidentbot.repro.hint_accept_rate; added traces around bundle generation for 95th latency analysis. Security/PII: bundler strips known PII keys using the existing sanitizer pipeline before packaging. Performance: typical bundle size reduced by ~4.3x on the internal dataset; average generation latency for 5m window is 380ms on a 4vCPU worker (median), 95th 1.2s. See perf numbers in docs for details. Related Linear: ENG-1423 (diagnostic UX), SRE-88 (oncall time savings). Related PRs: small SDK helper added in redwood-sdk-python (incoming). Contact: Aisha Patel (@aisha) for implementation, Carlos Mendes for ranking heuristics.

review_comments: Carlos Mendes: Nice approach. Can we make the default time-window configurable per-team? I worry about different services having different error surfaces.
Aisha Patel: Added team-specific window override in internal/config/flags.go and documented in runbooks. Also added server-side cap to avoid blowups.
Evelyn Cho: Please add a test case for sanitized PII removal when logs include email/ssn-like tokens.
Aisha Patel: Added a sanitizer test and a note about redaction behavior in the docs.
Liam O'Connor: Integration tests flaked once due to replay timing; I reran and CI is green. Approving after nits fixed.
Carlos Mendes: Approving — left one optional suggestion about ranking weights tuning in repro_ranker.go comments.
release_notes: Add context-sliced diagnostic bundles and prioritized repro hints to incident-bot. Feature gated; opt-in via BUNDLE_MODE=sliced. Metrics: incidentbot.bundle.size_bytes, incidentbot.repro.hints_generated. Improves mean time to mitigation by surfacing compact reproducible steps.
